tfb-k10.desc: FINAL PICK B3 (public 0.88281): multi-part queue swap (= tfb-j3 swap_queue2 code + 4 hard gates) on tfb-k9/submission_FDRTV.csv: private onset <- tfb-t2osp queue_submission_base.csv, private ongoing <- tfb-t2ogveto queue_submission_veto10.csv; asserts that no March queue row changed.
tfb-k10.runtime_note: not traced (light swap; tfb-j3 took 97 s)

tfb-k9.desc: FINAL PICK A3 (public 0.88281): on tfb-k5d/submission_K5D.csv: step M = flow LRTC ranks (24, 40, 10), 60 EM iterations, per (panel, split) released cube, q <- max(0.65 q + 0.35 max(q_lrtc, 20), 20) on ordinary state rows; step B = blackout rows v <- clip(0.85 v + 0.15 v_lrtc(8, 20, 20), 3, 1.05 vf), q <- max(0.85 q + 0.15 q_lrtc(8, 40, 10), 20); steps R (FD-gated recon) and T (1-D TV) verbatim from tfb-i4 / tfb-k5. Output submission_FDRTV.csv = the pick (queue / path_flow rows = the base = tfb-j4).
tfb-k9.runtime_note: not traced; expected 16-20 min (tfb-k7 = 1 LRTC per panel-month took 771 s; k9 runs 3)

tfb-k5d.desc: T1 mix K5D (EXP_T1_XGB): the tfb-i4d mix (0.5 FD bag + 0.5 old FTA bag), then 0.65 mix + 0.35 mean(t1catb, t1catb2), then 0.65 mix + 0.35 t1xgb, then blackout rows 0.25 mix + 0.75 t1bspec. Every state row recomputed; queue / path_flow rows copied from the base tfb-k3/submission_FDRTV.csv.

tfb-k3.desc: recon + TV (= tfb-i4 code, kaggle_jobs/swap_fdrecon_k3.py) on tfb-k3d. Only its queue / path_flow rows reach the picks (as the base of tfb-k5d).

tfb-k3d.desc: T1 mix K3D = tfb-i4d mix + 0.35 mean(t1catb, t1catb2), blackout override; base tfb-j4/submission_J4.csv (queue / path_flow rows). Only its queue / path_flow rows reach the picks.

tfb-j4.desc: previous pick A2 (0.88176): queue swap on tfb-i4 (private ongoing <- tfb-t2ogpvogf pvogfv). Its queue / path_flow rows are the A3 queue / path_flow rows.
